gen-gf-bellota-outfit: Loose, looping, hand-bent wire. Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine, best big and brief, while Outfit tucks its curves in neatly for everything smaller.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-amulya: Commanding from the first glance, Bellota Text draws every letter like a rounded rod, one weight throughout. Amulya is the quieter worker, its sans-serif curves leaving generous gaps for modern, steady reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-space-grotesk: Rounded, open, and unshaded: that is Bellota Text up top. Space Grotesk then keeps a long paragraph moving, its ribbon-width glyphs and breathing counters making sentences feel geometric and easy to follow.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-plein: Expressive and slow-moving, Bruno Ace lets each character take its own beat, counters open to the outside. Plein is the reliable one, guiding the eye into every round letter.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-spline-sans: Ruler-straight lines, spaced out and unhurried. Bruno Ace brings that lingering, one-character-per-beat rhythm, and Spline Sans answers with wide gaps and identical stroke weight, which makes the combination feel modern and approachable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, so paragraphs move along smoothly with generous openings in every curve. Bruno Ace above it keeps things expressive with its ruler-drawn, widely spaced capitals.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-outfit: Ruler-drawn and unhurried, with one character per beat. Outfit follows in the body, its curves stopping well short of closing, so a long stretch of text feels like smooth cable bent into letters beneath Bruno Ace.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-plus-jakarta-sans: Spaced-out, ruler-straight, and a little futuristic. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its monoline curves well apart beneath Bruno Ace, and that precise, modern restraint against the heading's lingering rhythm is the pairing's best trait.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-space-grotesk: Bruno Ace draws every line with a ruler, leaving its counters open to the outside and giving each character its own beat. And Space Grotesk, a plain sans, runs on as a ribbon of constant width, its breathing counters making paragraphs feel geometric and unhurried.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-chillax: Beaded letters strung along a long thread, open and expressive, set the mood for Bruno Ace SC. Chillax loosens things further with its spaghetti-like line, and that casual looseness is the pair's best trait.
